headword: {糖尿病患者|とうにょうびょうかんじゃ}
reading: とうにょうびょうかんじゃ

definitions.explanation: A person who has diabetes, a chronic condition in which the body cannot properly regulate blood sugar.

examples.japanese: {糖尿病患者|とうにょうびょうかんじゃ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: The number of diabetic patients is increasing.

examples.japanese: {糖尿病患者|とうにょうびょうかんじゃ}は{食事|しょくじ}に{気|き}をつける{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Diabetic patients need to be careful about their diet.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}は{糖尿病患者|とうにょうびょうかんじゃ}に{毎日|まいにち}{運動|うんどう}するよう{勧|すす}めた。
examples.english: The doctor advised the diabetic patient to exercise every day.

notes:
Written {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (diabetes) + {患者|かんじゃ} (patient). The suffix {患者|かんじゃ} combines with many illness names (e.g. がん{患者|かんじゃ}, cancer patient).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}: diabetes — the condition itself
- {患者|かんじゃ}: patient — the general base word
